feature_hypotheses: Smoothed (user, author) long_view rate (prior_days, m around 20) is the highest-value history group because it varies within a user and crosses with video/author fields; test first via history_features with use_user_author enabled.

recency and video_age buckets add within-user temporal signal; enabling them alongside user_author should beat user_rate alone, since user-side-only groups contribute nothing through the first-order term under within-user GAUC.

is_click as a single auxiliary head at aux_weight 0.1-0.3 improves validation GAUC through shared embeddings given its ~0.76 train correlation with long_view; play_time (censoring bias) and is_like (1.9% prevalence) are deprioritized.

group_softmax with K=4 and temperature 1.0 approximates the evaluated within-user list better than single-pair BPR on users with at least 5 mixed-label impressions; duplicate negatives within groups reduce effective K and must be deduplicated at sampling time.
